9.4.2 Eccentric load testWith test length as LI and the prop set with an eccentricity of 54 mm at the crown ( the line of thrust shall pass through the centre of the base plate and a point 54 mm off. set from the centre of the crown ), the load on the prop shall be gradually increased till the prop yields. This test shall normally be made over small lengths of yield, over a range of working loads. 9.5 Release Test - Ease and method of release shall be investigated and the rate of closure noted while the release valve is held open. Particular note shall be taken as to whether release may be effected from a safe position. 9.6 Sfafic Leakage Tesfs load test ( see 9.4.1 ). These tests ( see 9.6.1 to 9.6.3) shall be carried out after conducting axial!

Note shall be taken of any tendency for hydraulic fluid to leak. 9.6.1Leakage in unloaded propsfrom the prop. With the prop lying on the ground either in horizontal or in inclined position, it shall, be noted if any hydraulic fluid leaks from the prop. 9.6.2 Leakage in prop loaded with low pressure various loads up to its maximum setting load. shall be recorded over a period of 72 hours. - The prop shall be set vertically in a rigid frame at: The rate of loss of load and the total loss of load

9.6.3 Leakage in prop loaded with high pressure - The prop shall be set vertically in a testing, machine and loaded gradually up to 90 percent of nominal yield load. The prop shall be held at this, load for at least 10 minutes and fall in load, if any shall be noted. 9.7 Overload Test

9.7.1 With prop extended - With test length as LI and relief valve blocked, the prop shall be set An axial load gradually increasing to one and a half times the vertically in the testing machine. The prop shall be held at this load for 5 minutes. nominal yield load shall be applied on the prop. Any damage to prop or its components shall be recorded. The prop conforming to this test shalO be subjected to axial load test (see 9.4.1 ) again and change in characteristic of prop noted. 9.7.2 With prop closed - With test length as L, the prop shall be set vertically in the testing machine and the load on the prop shall be gradually increased to twice the nominal yield load. The prop shall be held at this load for five minutes. Any damage or change of characteristics of the prop shall be noted as specified in 9.7.1. 9.6 Internal dismantled Examination of Prop - After conducting for the following observations: the tests specified in 9.3 to 9.7 the prop shall be

a) Any damage to prop or its component, b) Any dirt, c) Any flaking d) Any erosion of surface or pitting plating, and of valve member.

9.9 This standard does not prevent any other tests in addition to those already described in 9.3 to 9.8, to be carried out optionally by the testing authority of the institute or by the manufacturer, Additional tests may also be carried out to investigate any novel feature. 10.
